payload.message:
JIRA sprint task allocation. Each agent chooses at most one micro-task (or skips). Maximize tasks completed, prefer higher-priority tasks, then minimize total cost. Avoid duplicate task selections and infeasible assignments.

This blackboard is a private communication channel.
Participants: Carina, Clarinda, Ivette, Shonna

payload.content: Planning coordination: I am Ivette. I have 4 hours availability and strong skills in infrastructure (0.88) and documentation (0.85). I see critical priority tasks on documentation reviews and tests, and medium priority tasks on machine-learning with lower costs on triage and review. I am considering claiming either ISSUE-0001::triage (cost 2.96) or ISSUE-0002::review (cost 3.16). I welcome others' preferences to avoid conflicts.

Clarinda here. I have 9 hours available with top skills in infrastructure (0.89). I see critical priority tasks on ISSUE-0002 but their costs are very high for me (30 to 60). I prefer to focus on ISSUE-0001 tasks related to infrastructure, especially triage or review which have lower costs (2.94 and 3.68). Ivette, since you are considering ISSUE-0001::triage and ISSUE-0002::review, I am inclined to avoid triage to prevent overlap and can consider review or docs instead. Let's coordinate to maximize task coverage and avoid conflicts.

Carina here. I have strong documentation skills and 8 hours available. I see critical priority tasks on ISSUE-0002 related to documentation. I prefer to take one of these critical tasks to maximize priority value. I am considering ISSUE-0002::review or ISSUE-0002::test, both fitting my skills and availability with manageable costs. I will avoid ISSUE-0001 tasks to prevent conflicts with Clarinda and Ivette. Let's finalize choices to cover critical tasks efficiently.

Shonna here. I have 7 hours available and strong skills in machine-learning. I prefer to focus on ISSUE-0001 tasks related to machine-learning, especially triage or review due to my cost preferences. I will avoid ISSUE-0002 critical tasks to let Carina and Ivette cover them. Looking forward to others' final choices to avoid overlaps and maximize task coverage.

I will prioritize ISSUE-0001::triage or ISSUE-0001::review tasks given my skills and cost constraints. If those are taken, I may consider ISSUE-0001::docs as a fallback. I aim to maximize task completion without duplicating tasks others prefer.

Ivette here. Acknowledging Clarinda's preference to avoid triage and considering her inclination for review or docs. Also noting Carina's focus on ISSUE-0002 critical tasks and Shonna's preference for ISSUE-0001 triage or review. I propose I take ISSUE-0001::triage due to my lower cost and strong skills in infrastructure, leaving ISSUE-0002::review for Carina or others. Please confirm or suggest adjustments.

Ivette coordinating: I will take ISSUE-0001::triage if no objections. Clarinda, please confirm if you prefer ISSUE-0001::review or docs to avoid overlap with me and Shonna. Carina, I support you taking ISSUE-0002 critical tasks. Shonna, do you confirm triage or review preference?

Clarinda here. I agree with Ivette taking ISSUE-0001::triage to leverage her lower cost and skills there. I will focus on ISSUE-0001::review or docs to complement the triage task. Shonna, if you prefer triage or review, please confirm so we avoid overlap. Carina, I support you taking ISSUE-0002 critical tasks to maximize priority coverage. Let's confirm our choices to finalize assignments efficiently.

Carina here. I confirm my preference for ISSUE-0002::review or ISSUE-0002::test to cover critical priority documentation tasks with manageable costs. I support Ivette taking ISSUE-0001::triage and Clarinda taking ISSUE-0001::review or docs to avoid overlap. Shonna, please confirm your preference for ISSUE-0001::triage or review to finalize our coordination.

Shonna confirming preference for ISSUE-0001::review due to machine-learning skills and cost considerations, leaving ISSUE-0001::triage to Ivette and ISSUE-0001::docs to Clarinda. This should maximize coverage and avoid overlap. Looking forward to final confirmations.

Shonna confirms focusing on ISSUE-0001 tasks related to machine-learning, specifically the review task, to complement Ivette's triage and Clarinda's docs choices. Supporting Carina on critical ISSUE-0002 tasks for documentation.
